evidence: The workbook check 34 and skill procedure ask whether the judge is instructed to exercise the changing behavior. Frozen task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:146-149 requires six-second idle waits followed by actual click and focused key/input, then Stop and attempted old-handler interaction; :174-180 requires genuinely pending replacement/Stop with observations beyond callback deadlines; :280-286 requires typing in a live preview and clicking Paint picture before checking rollback; :395-404 toggles Auto-run, measures its delay, makes timed edits, and observes cancellation/manual-run/new/load windows; :450-460 batches Run and ten-second shared-deadline observation. Polish prompt.md:47-49 requires actual keyboard traversal, and polish/judge.toml:23 requires each pane reached and used at 390x844. Visual prompt.md:42-43 and visual/judge.toml:99 require desktop/mobile comparison of actual surfaces. One theme is publicly sufficient (instruction.md:7), so no theme toggle is missing. Verified existing scripted evidence (not configured grading) shows S03 click after 6100.48 ms, key/input after 6105.30 ms, with marker counts increasing from 0 to 1; surface-results.json records actual edit/Run/preview/Clear at 390x844 and keyboard-only history navigation. All indexed artifact hashes and every frozen solution file against the measured installation were checked in per-row-review/evidence/34/verification.json. Source protocols satisfy this row; no configured judge score or full judge-completion measurement is claimed or waived.
counterexample: Considered a first-paint-correct app whose preview handlers die after five seconds: S03's required six-second idle click and key/input expose it. Considered a conforming single-theme app using native focus, Escape/Tab, and a stacked or tabbed mobile workspace: the stated acceptance alternatives prevent a layout/theme/shortcut false failure. These are protocol counterexample analyses, not new mutated-app runs.
